profile.headline: Software Developer at Panoramic Software, Inc.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Development, debugging, and optimization of report SQL, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
Development of reports in Crystal Reports, and Jasper (iReport).
Development, maintenance, and optimization of ETL processes for new and current customer.
Communicate with teammates and customers as necessary regarding report/software development, project management, and issue resolution.

positions.title: Customer Service Technician
positions.description:
On-site maintenance of electro-mechanical fountain equipment.
Communicate with teammates and customers to resolve issues in a prompt and professional manner.
Perform maintenance and address customer issues in a fast-paced environment within short timeframes.

positions.title: EDT Analyst II
positions.description:
Received and loaded client data in a timely manner.
Provided technical guidance to customers during implementation/testing phases.
Addressed and resolved customer issues related to data transmission, receipt, processing and import.

positions.title: Senior Production Specialist
positions.description:
Managed the transmission, receipt, and processing of data to and from third-party vendors.
Monitored nightly processes for errors, and corrected issues as necessary.
Assisted in the development and implementation of the new processes.

positions.title: Assembly Technician
positions.description:
Assembled and calibrated optical, proximity, and flow sensors to customer specifications.
Conducted testing and evaluation of returned sensors.
Provided phone support for client onsite issues.
Maintained inventory of parts and supplies for the assembly, testing, repair, and shipping of products.
Managed shipping and receiving of products to and from the customer.

positions.title: F-16 Avionics Technician
positions.description:
Performed flightline installation, maintenance, and repair of avionics systems on the F-16 aircraft.
Performed tasks under extreme conditions, troubleshooting and correcting problems within very short timeframes.
Documented tasks and actions in an effort to spot trends and develop methods to improve efficiency.
